description.zh-CN: 装在带脚轮立杆上的多参数床旁监护仪，持续显示心电、无创血压、血氧饱和度、呼吸频率与呼气末二氧化碳。
description.en: Multiparameter bedside monitor on a rolling stand, showing continuous ECG, NIBP, SpO₂, respiratory rate and end-tidal CO₂.

usage.zh-CN: 连接心电导联、血氧探头、血压袖带（插管患者接二氧化碳采样）后连续监测；核对报警阈值并关注趋势，报警时先看患者再看屏幕。
usage.en: Attach ECG leads, SpO₂ probe and NIBP cuff (plus a CO₂ sampling line if intubated) for continuous monitoring; check alarm limits and trends, and always assess the patient before trusting the screen.

description.zh-CN: 推车式十二导联心电图机，带显示屏、热敏打印纸和导联线挂臂。
description.en: Cart-mounted 12-lead electrocardiograph with display, thermal printer and a lead-wire arm.

usage.zh-CN: 按标准位置贴放肢体与胸前导联，嘱患者平卧放松，记录 10 秒十二导联心电图并与既往图比较。
usage.en: Place limb and precordial electrodes in the standard positions, have the patient lie still, record a 10-second 12-lead tracing and compare it with previous ECGs.

name.en: Place the electrodes and connect the leads

description.zh-CN: 小推车上的手动/自动体外除颤监护仪，配除颤手柄、电极片、能量旋钮和心电显示屏。
description.en: Manual/AED defibrillator-monitor on a small cart with paddles, pads, an energy selector and an ECG display.

usage.zh-CN: 识别可电击心律（室颤/无脉性室速）后选择能量、充电、确认所有人离开患者再放电；同步电复律需开启同步模式，也可贴电极片行经皮起搏。
usage.en: For a shockable rhythm (VF or pulseless VT) select energy, charge, clear everyone and shock; switch on sync for cardioversion, or use pads for transcutaneous pacing.

description.zh-CN: 红色抢救车，分层抽屉存放复苏药物、气道及静脉通路用物，车上配便携吸引器、简易呼吸器、锐器盒、氧气瓶和心肺复苏按压板。
description.en: Red resuscitation cart with drawers of ACLS drugs, airway and IV supplies, carrying portable suction, a bag-valve-mask, sharps bin, oxygen cylinder and CPR board.

usage.zh-CN: 抢救时拉断封条，按抽屉分区取用肾上腺素、胺碘酮等急救药及插管用物、吸引和简易呼吸器；用后清点补充并重新封存。
usage.en: Break the seal in an emergency and take adrenaline, amiodarone, intubation kit, suction and the bag-valve-mask from their drawers; restock, check and reseal after use.

description.zh-CN: 护理治疗车：抽屉内备静脉留置针、采血管、敷贴、止血带、消毒用品和冲管液，台面放锐器盒和手消毒液，用于床旁静脉穿刺置管与采血。
description.en: Nursing treatment cart: drawers of IV cannulas, blood-sample tubes, dressings, tourniquets, skin prep and flushes, with a sharps bin and hand rub on top, for cannulation and blood sampling at the bedside.

usage.zh-CN: 推到床旁，手卫生后取用留置针和采血管，穿刺置管并同时采血，固定敷贴、冲管；锐器即刻入盒，用后补充物品。
usage.en: Wheel it to the bedside, clean your hands, take a cannula and sample tubes, cannulate and draw the bloods together, secure and flush the line; sharps straight into the bin, restock after use.

name.zh-CN: 墙式氧气/负压吸引终端

description.zh-CN: 床头中心供氧与负压吸引终端，配绿色氧气流量表、湿化瓶、负压调节表和吸引瓶。
description.en: Bed-head medical gas panel with a green oxygen flowmeter and humidifier, plus a wall-suction regulator and collection canister.

usage.zh-CN: 按目标血氧饱和度调节氧流量（鼻导管 1–6 L/min，面罩或储氧面罩更高）；吸引前设定合适负压并检查吸引瓶液位。
usage.en: Titrate oxygen flow to the SpO₂ target (nasal cannula 1–6 L/min, higher via face mask or non-rebreather); set the suction pressure and check the canister level before suctioning.

description.zh-CN: 固定在双轮推车上的医用氧气瓶，带瓶阀、减压器、压力表和流量调节。
description.en: Medical oxygen cylinder on a two-wheel trolley with valve, regulator, contents gauge and flow selector.

usage.zh-CN: 使用前查看压力表余量，缓慢开启瓶阀后调节流量；转运前估算可供氧时间，用毕关闭瓶阀并泄压。
usage.en: Check the contents gauge, open the valve slowly and set the flow; estimate the remaining duration before transport, then close the valve and vent the regulator after use.

description.zh-CN: 带四爪挂钩、可升降的移动输液架，挂有输液袋和输液器。
description.en: Height-adjustable mobile IV stand with a four-hook crown carrying fluid bags and giving sets.

usage.zh-CN: 建立外周静脉通路后悬挂液体，排气并调节滴速；输注前核对药名、剂量、浓度和有效期。
usage.en: After establishing peripheral IV access, hang the fluid, prime the line and set the drip rate; check drug, dose, concentration and expiry before starting.

description.zh-CN: 安装在输液架上的两台容量型输液泵，可精确控制胰岛素、血管活性药物或肝素等的输注速度。
description.en: Two volumetric infusion pumps on an IV pole for precisely controlled insulin, vasopressor or heparin infusions.

usage.zh-CN: 装入专用输液管路，设定药物浓度、速率和总量，双人核对后启动；出现阻塞或气泡报警时检查管路和穿刺部位。
usage.en: Load the dedicated set, program concentration, rate and volume to be infused, double-check and start; for occlusion or air-in-line alarms inspect the line and cannula site.

description.zh-CN: ICU 有创/无创呼吸机，配触摸屏、加温湿化器、吸气与呼气管路和管路支架。
description.en: ICU invasive/non-invasive ventilator with touchscreen, heated humidifier, inspiratory and expiratory limbs and a hose support arm.

usage.zh-CN: 选择通气模式并设置潮气量（约 6–8 mL/kg 理想体重）、呼吸频率、PEEP 和 FiO₂，之后根据血气、气道压力和氧合调整。
usage.en: Choose a mode and set tidal volume (about 6–8 mL/kg ideal body weight), rate, PEEP and FiO₂, then adjust to blood gases, airway pressures and oxygenation.

description.zh-CN: 带双吸引瓶、负压表、调节旋钮和吸引管的移动式电动吸引器。
description.en: Mobile electric suction unit with twin collection canisters, vacuum gauge, regulator and suction tubing.

usage.zh-CN: 连接吸引管和吸头，设定合适负压（成人气道吸引一般约 100–150 mmHg），清除口咽或气道分泌物，并观察吸出物的量和性状。
usage.en: Connect the tubing and a Yankauer or catheter, set an appropriate vacuum (typically about 100–150 mmHg for adult airway suction), clear oropharyngeal or airway secretions and note their volume and character.

description.zh-CN: 移动支架上的压缩式雾化器，配雾化杯、面罩和送气管。
description.en: Compressor nebulizer on a rolling stand with medication cup, face mask and tubing.

usage.zh-CN: 将医嘱药液（如支气管扩张剂）加入雾化杯，连接面罩后开机，嘱患者平静呼吸直至药液雾化完毕，治疗前后评估呼吸音与血氧。
usage.en: Fill the cup with the prescribed solution (e.g. a bronchodilator), fit the mask, switch on and have the patient breathe normally until the dose is nebulised; reassess breath sounds and SpO₂ before and after.

description.zh-CN: 放置血糖仪、试纸、采血针、棉签、锐器盒和手持式床旁分析仪的即时检验推车。
description.en: Point-of-care cart with a glucometer, test strips, lancets, swabs, a sharps bin and a handheld analyser.

usage.zh-CN: 消毒指尖后采集毛细血管血，测定血糖、血酮或床旁肌钙蛋白/血红蛋白，记录检测时间并按需复测。
usage.en: Clean the fingertip, take a capillary sample and measure glucose, ketones or bedside troponin/haemoglobin; record the time of the test and repeat as needed.

description.zh-CN: 墙装式诊断系统：带螺旋线的检耳镜与检眼镜手柄、窥耳器分配盒、壁挂式血压计和听诊器。
description.en: Wall-mounted diagnostic system with coiled-cord otoscope and ophthalmoscope handles, a speculum dispenser, an aneroid sphygmomanometer and a stethoscope.

usage.zh-CN: 取下检耳镜或检眼镜检查外耳道、鼓膜和眼底，使用袖带测量手动血压并听诊心肺，用后将手柄放回充电座。
usage.en: Lift the otoscope or ophthalmoscope to examine the ear canal, tympanic membrane and fundus, take a manual blood pressure and auscultate, then return the handles to their chargers.

description.zh-CN: 麻醉工作站，集成气体流量计、挥发罐、循环呼吸回路与二氧化碳吸收罐、风箱式麻醉呼吸机和患者监护仪。
description.en: Anaesthesia workstation integrating gas flowmeters, vaporisers, a circle breathing system with CO₂ absorber, bellows ventilator and patient monitor.

usage.zh-CN: 麻醉前完成机器自检和回路检漏，设定新鲜气体流量与挥发罐浓度；诱导插管后接机械通气，持续监测呼气末二氧化碳和生命体征。
usage.en: Complete the pre-use machine check and leak test, set fresh gas flows and vaporiser concentration, ventilate after induction and intubation, and monitor end-tidal CO₂ and vital signs throughout.

description.zh-CN: 电动液压多功能手术床，分节软垫、侧轨、双侧臂板和麻醉头架。
description.en: Electro-hydraulic multi-section operating table with padded segments, side rails, arm boards and an anaesthesia screen frame.

usage.zh-CN: 根据术式摆放体位并系好约束带，衬垫受压部位；可调节高度、倾斜和各节角度以显露术野。
usage.en: Position the patient for the procedure, fasten the safety strap and pad pressure points; adjust height, tilt and section angles to expose the field.

description.zh-CN: 吊顶式双灯头 LED 无影灯，带弹簧平衡臂和可消毒手柄。
description.en: Ceiling-mounted twin-head LED surgical light on spring-balanced arms with sterilisable handles.

usage.zh-CN: 通过无菌手柄调整灯头位置和焦距，使术野照明均匀无阴影；调整前后避免触碰非无菌部位。
usage.en: Use the sterile handles to position and focus the heads for even, shadow-free illumination of the surgical field without touching non-sterile surfaces.

description.zh-CN: 铺有无菌巾的不锈钢器械台，摆放器械盘、弯盘、圆碗、纱布、注射器和缝线，下层放置器械包。
description.en: Stainless-steel back table under a sterile drape with an instrument tray, kidney dish, basin, gauze, syringe and sutures, with wrapped sets below.

usage.zh-CN: 器械护士按使用顺序摆放器械，保持无菌区域，并在关闭切口前后清点纱布与器械数量。
usage.en: The scrub nurse lays out instruments in order of use, maintains the sterile field and counts swabs and instruments before and after closure.

description.zh-CN: 病区自动化药品调配柜，配触摸屏、指纹识别、退药口和带指示灯的抽屉。
description.en: Ward automated dispensing cabinet with touchscreen, fingerprint reader, return bin and lighted drawers.

usage.zh-CN: 指纹登录后选择患者和医嘱，药柜点亮对应抽屉；取药后核对药名、剂量和患者信息并在系统中确认。
usage.en: Log in by fingerprint, select the patient and order; the cabinet lights the correct drawer, then verify drug, dose and patient and confirm the removal.

description.zh-CN: 2–8 °C 玻璃门药品冷藏柜，存放胰岛素、疫苗等冷链药品，顶部有数字温度显示。
description.en: Glass-door 2–8 °C pharmacy refrigerator for insulin, vaccines and other cold-chain medicines, with a digital temperature display.

usage.zh-CN: 取药前确认温度记录在 2–8 °C 范围内，取用后及时关门，遵循近效期先用原则。
usage.en: Confirm the temperature log is within 2–8 °C before use, close the door promptly and use the earliest-expiring stock first.

description.zh-CN: 药房双联开放式货架，按颜色分区放置药品周转箱，顶层存放整箱药品。
description.en: Double-bay pharmacy shelving with colour-coded medication bins and boxed stock on the top shelf.

usage.zh-CN: 按药名和剂型分区存放，外观或读音相似的药品分开放置以防差错，并定期检查效期。
usage.en: Store stock by name and formulation, keep look-alike/sound-alike drugs apart to prevent errors, and check expiry dates regularly.

description.zh-CN: 2–6 °C 血液专用冷藏柜，带圆盘温度记录仪和报警装置，分层抽篮存放红细胞悬液。
description.en: 2–6 °C blood bank refrigerator with a circular chart temperature recorder and alarms, holding red-cell units in pull-out baskets.

usage.zh-CN: 发血前由两人核对患者身份、血型和交叉配血结果；血液出库后应尽快（通常 30 分钟内）开始输注。
usage.en: Before issue, two staff check patient identity, blood group and crossmatch; start the transfusion promptly after removal (usually within 30 minutes).

description.zh-CN: 带血泵、肝素泵、透析器、静脉壶、空气探测器和浓缩液桶的血液透析机。
description.en: Haemodialysis machine with blood pump, heparin pump, dialyser, venous drip chamber, air detector and concentrate containers.

usage.zh-CN: 预冲管路和透析器后连接血管通路，设定血流量、超滤目标和治疗时间，治疗中监测静脉压、跨膜压和血压。
usage.en: Prime the lines and dialyser, connect the vascular access, set blood flow, ultrafiltration goal and duration, then monitor venous and transmembrane pressures and blood pressure during treatment.

description.zh-CN: 移动式 LED 检查灯，带鹅颈软管和万向轮底座。
description.en: Mobile LED examination lamp with a gooseneck arm on a castor base.

usage.zh-CN: 将灯头对准检查部位获得聚焦照明，用于皮肤、伤口、口咽或妇科检查。
usage.en: Aim the head at the area of interest for focused illumination during skin, wound, oropharyngeal or pelvic examination.

description.zh-CN: 放置峰流速仪、一次性咬嘴、手持肺量计和哮喘分区图的呼吸功能检测台。
description.en: Respiratory testing station with peak-flow meters, disposable mouthpieces, a handheld spirometer and an asthma zone chart.

usage.zh-CN: 嘱患者站立深吸气后含紧咬嘴快速用力呼气，重复三次取最佳值，并与预计值或个人最佳值比较以判断分区。
usage.en: Have the patient stand, inhale fully, seal the mouthpiece and blow out hard and fast; take the best of three and compare with predicted or personal best to assign the zone.

description.zh-CN: 带电子显示、扶手和身高测量杆的立柱式医用体重秤。
description.en: Medical column scale with a digital display, handgrips and a sliding height rod (stadiometer).

usage.zh-CN: 患者脱鞋站在秤台中央测体重，背靠测量杆放下头板读取身高，用于计算 BMI 或按体重给药。
usage.en: Weigh the patient without shoes in the centre of the platform, lower the headpiece to read height, and use the results for BMI or weight-based dosing.

description.zh-CN: 钢架软垫治疗床：可调头枕、一次性床单卷、高约 0.7 米。
description.en: A steel-framed padded treatment couch with an adjustable headrest and a paper roll, about 0.7 m high.

usage.zh-CN: 门诊、骨科和康复查体：患者坐于床边或平卧，便于检查关节活动度与神经功能。
usage.en: Outpatient, orthopaedic and rehabilitation examinations: the patient sits on its edge or lies flat for joint range-of-motion and neurological checks.

description.zh-CN: 3 米长、可调高度的步态训练平行杠，木质底座铺防滑垫。
description.en: Height-adjustable 3 m gait-training parallel bars on a wooden base with a non-slip mat.

usage.zh-CN: 康复训练：患者双手扶杠练习站立、负重和行走，治疗师在旁保护。
usage.en: Rehabilitation: the patient holds both rails to practise standing, weight bearing and walking while the therapist guards.

description.zh-CN: 带阻力调节和心率显示屏的立式康复踏车。
description.en: An upright rehabilitation exercise bike with adjustable resistance and a heart-rate console.

usage.zh-CN: 心肺康复与下肢肌力训练：从低阻力开始，监测心率和主观用力程度。
usage.en: Cardiopulmonary rehabilitation and leg strengthening: start at low resistance and watch heart rate and perceived exertion.

description.zh-CN: 壁挂式木质肋木，横杆间距 25 厘米。
description.en: Wall-mounted wooden stall bars with rungs every 25 cm.

usage.zh-CN: 牵伸、平衡和上肢力量训练时供患者扶握。
usage.en: A handhold for stretching, balance and upper-limb strengthening exercises.

description.zh-CN: 1.2 × 2 米防滑运动康复垫。
description.en: A 1.2 × 2 m non-slip rehabilitation exercise mat.

usage.zh-CN: 地面训练：翻身、桥式运动和核心稳定训练。
usage.en: Floor exercises: rolling, bridging and core stability work.
